NONE: › a person, especially a child or a man, who does things that you disapprove of, but who you still like

example: I caught those little/young rascals dressing up in my clothes.
這幫小壞蛋穿著我的衣服玩耍時被我抓了個正著。

NONE: › a large number of unpleasant events of the same type
（一下子出現的）大量令人不快的事
C2 careless or unwise, without thought for what might happen or result

example: I've got an itchy rash all over my chest.
我胸部出滿了疹子，癢得要命。
If you stay in the sun too long you'll get (a) heat rash.
如果你在陽光下呆得太久，就會生痱子。
UK He came out/up in a rash after he fell in a patch of nettles.
他摔倒在一片蕁麻地裡，結果身上就起了疹子。
There has been a rash of robberies/accidents/complaints in the last two months.
過去兩個月中，突然發生很多起搶劫案／一下出了很多宗事故／接二連三收到多宗投訴。

那個決定太輕率了——你沒有考慮到這樣做的代價。
[ + to infinitive ] I think it was a bit rash of them to get married when they'd only known each other for a few weeks.
我覺得他們剛認識幾週就結婚有些草率。

我拿蘋果餵馬時，它用粗糙的舌頭舔我的手。
